title: Several workout-tab failures tell the member to try again but leave no trace of why
what: If sharing as text fails, a new routine cannot be created, the routines list cannot be read, or the workout menu on Profile cannot load, the member sees a try-again message but the real error is thrown away. Restoring an open workout and reading the default rest at start-up also drop their errors without a word.
expected: Every failure that shows a message also writes the error to the log, so a repeat problem can be diagnosed.
who: members and the team diagnosing reports
fix_line: Write the error to the log in each of these failure paths

title: The warm-up, drop and failure set letters are worked out separately in four places
what: The rule that turns a set into W, D, F or a number is written again in the set row, the set type sheet, the workout recap and the saved workout page. They already differ: the saved page numbers normal sets, the recap shows no number at all. A change to set types has to be made four times and can drift.
expected: One shared rule gives each set its letter or number, used by every screen.
fix_line: Move the set letter rule into one place and use it everywhere

title: Three separate copies of the clock format for workout and rest times
what: The rest timer, the minimised workout bar and the workout screen each have their own way to write a time as minutes and seconds. The rest timer's copy has no hours, so a rest over an hour would read like 75:00 where the others write 1:15:00; the bar and the screen round seconds differently.
expected: One clock format used by every timer on the phone.
fix_line: Use the one shared clock format in the rest timer and the workout bar

title: 33 workout-tab parts have no test that loads them, and no test draws any of them
what: The workout recap, Up next card, routines list, settings card, share sheets, profile feed and 27 more parts are imported by no test at all. The phone tests run without a screen, so none of these parts is ever drawn; the tests that do mention them only search the code for certain words, which passes even when the screen misbehaves.
expected: Each of these parts is drawn by at least one test that taps it and checks what the member sees.
fix_line: Add screen tests that draw these parts and check what they show

title: Some tests of the workout parts wait on real time and can fail on a slow build machine
what: A set-entry test waits a fixed 30 thousandths of a second for a save to land, a photo backup test waits 20 for another step to get going, and the plate calculator test fails if a sum takes over 2 seconds. On a busy build machine these can fail, or pass without testing the race they were written for.
expected: Tests wait for the event itself or use a fake clock, never a fixed real-time pause.
fix_line: Replace the fixed waits with waiting for the result or a fake clock
